name: Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator
author: Belov Digital Agency

sections.description:
Introducing the Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator – the most comprehensive and user-friendly financial planning tool for your WordPress website!

Whether you’re a financial advisor, real estate professional, or simply want to provide valuable resources to your visitors, this plugin is an essential addition to your site. With its advanced features and intuitive design, the Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator helps users make informed decisions about loans and mortgages with ease.

A POWERFUL FINANCIAL TOOL AT YOUR FINGERTIPS

Calculating loan payments and mortgage terms can be complex and time-consuming. Our plugin simplifies this process, allowing your visitors to quickly and accurately determine their financial obligations. Install it now and watch your website become a go-to resource for loan and mortgage information!

FEATURES THAT SET US APART

  • Versatile Calculation Options: Choose between a standard Loan calculator or a Mortgage calculator with an optional Down Payment feature.
  • Currency Customization: Select from a wide range of currencies to suit your audience’s needs.
  • Flexible Payment Periods: Users can calculate payments on various schedules – Annually, Semi-Annually, Quarterly, Monthly, Fortnightly, or Weekly.
  • Instant Results: Get immediate calculations without unnecessary clicks.
  • Comprehensive Payment Schedule: View a detailed table of payments based on the selected payment period.
  • Email Results: Users can request detailed results sent directly to their email.
  • Modern, Customizable Design: Choose from various color schemes and font sizes to match your website’s aesthetics.
  • Versatile Placement: Easily add the calculator to any page, post, or sidebar using a simple shortcode.

HOW IT WORKS

Our Ultimate Loan & Mortgage Calculator provides you with a shortcode to place on your website’s page, post, or sidebar. Position it strategically to capture your visitors’ attention!

Customizable Defaults

Set default values for Loan Balance, Interest Rate, and Down Payment to streamline the user experience.

Date Formatting

Choose the date format for the initial payment to suit your region’s preferences.

User-Friendly Admin Panel

Enjoy a sleek, intuitive admin area where you can easily configure all aspects of the calculator.

BOOST USER ENGAGEMENT AND LEAD GENERATION

By offering this valuable tool on your website, you’ll increase user engagement and time spent on your site. The email feature also provides an excellent opportunity for lead generation and follow-up marketing.

PRO FEATURES COMING SOON

We’re constantly working to improve our plugin. Stay tuned for upcoming PRO features, including:

  • Multiple design templates
  • Lead collection and CSV export
  • Third-party integrations
  • Advanced styling options
  • Customizable PDF results
  • Admin panel translations
  • Email template customization
  • Elementor widget support

And much more!

TRANSLATIONS

  • English: default, always included.
  • Your language: Coming soon!

Note: The plugin is localized/translateable by default. This is very important for all users worldwide. So please contribute your language to the plugin to make it even more useful. For translating, please use the POT file, which is always included in the plugin’s languages/ folder.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly, or upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ultimate-loan-mortgage-calculator directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Choose the Dashboard->Loan & Mortgage menu item to configure the plugin.
  4. Place the shortcode [ultimate_loan_mortgage_calculator] in your pages or posts where you want the calculator to appear.
sections.faq:
Can I customize the colors of the calculator?

Yes! You can choose from various color schemes in the plugin settings to match your website’s design.

Is it possible to set default values for the calculator?

Absolutely! You can set default values for Loan Balance, Interest Rate, and Down Payment in the plugin settings.

Does the plugin support different currencies?

Yes, you can select from a wide range of currencies to suit your needs.

Can users get the results via email?

Yes, users have the option to request detailed results sent directly to their email address.

Is there a PRO version available?

We’re currently working on a PRO version with advanced features. Stay tuned for its release!
